_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: Thursday/Friday ↔ Sunday/Monday
axes.rationale: All three lenses agree: the positive end carries Monday, Sunday, Mondays and Mon, and the negative end carries Friday, Fri, Fridays and Thursday, so the axis separates late-week days from the start of the week.

axes.label: midweek (Tuesday/Wednesday) ↔ weekend (Saturday/Sunday)
axes.rationale: All three lenses agree: the positive end has Sunday, Saturdays and weekends, and the negative end has Wednesday, nesday, Tuesday and Wed, though some junk tokens are mixed in.

axes.label: unclear (Fridays/Mondays plural vs. fragments)
axes.rationale: Apart from Fridays and Mondays at the positive end, the lens tokens are subword fragments (acci, atown, eenth, funcs), and the real-logit tokens mix prepositions with month names without a clear pattern.
